headline.source: Investigations supervisor · Pacific Ridge Police Department
headline.en: Investigations supervisor · Pacific Ridge Police Department
headline.es: Supervisor de investigaciones · Pacific Ridge Police Department

biography.source: Coordinates incident review, evidence handovers and field documentation for the investigations team. Twelve years of experience in patrol and investigative support, with a focus on clear records, chain of custody and communication between shifts.
biography.en: Coordinates incident review, evidence handovers and field documentation for the investigations team. Twelve years of experience in patrol and investigative support, with a focus on clear records, chain of custody and communication between shifts.
biography.es: Coordina la revisión de incidentes, la entrega de evidencias y la documentación de campo del equipo de investigaciones. Cuenta con doce años de experiencia en patrullaje y apoyo investigativo, con énfasis en expedientes claros, cadena de custodia y comunicación entre turnos.

headline.source: Crime scene investigator · Pacific Ridge Police Department
headline.en: Crime scene investigator · Pacific Ridge Police Department
headline.es: Investigadora de escenas del delito · Pacific Ridge Police Department

biography.source: Documents incident scenes, prepares photographic records and coordinates evidence collection with investigators. Specializes in scene organization, traceable observations and consistent handovers between field and laboratory teams.
biography.en: Documents incident scenes, prepares photographic records and coordinates evidence collection with investigators. Specializes in scene organization, traceable observations and consistent handovers between field and laboratory teams.
biography.es: Documenta las escenas de incidentes, prepara registros fotográficos y coordina la recogida de evidencias con los investigadores. Se especializa en la organización de escenas, observaciones trazables y entregas consistentes entre los equipos de campo y laboratorio.

headline.source: Evidence and records technician · Pacific Ridge Police Department
headline.en: Evidence and records technician · Pacific Ridge Police Department
headline.es: Técnico de evidencias y expedientes · Pacific Ridge Police Department

biography.source: Maintains the evidence inventory, verifies intake records and prepares material for authorized case review. Supports investigators with organized attachments, equipment checks and accurate records of every evidence transfer.
biography.en: Maintains the evidence inventory, verifies intake records and prepares material for authorized case review. Supports investigators with organized attachments, equipment checks and accurate records of every evidence transfer.
biography.es: Mantiene el inventario de evidencias, verifica los registros de ingreso y prepara material para la revisión autorizada de casos. Apoya a los investigadores con adjuntos organizados, comprobaciones de equipos y registros precisos de cada traslado de evidencias.

headline.source: Registered nurse and unit coordinator · California Valley Medical Center
headline.en: Registered nurse and unit coordinator · California Valley Medical Center
headline.es: Enfermera y coordinadora de unidad · California Valley Medical Center

biography.source: Coordinates the nursing shift, patient handovers and follow-up documentation. Fifteen years of experience in inpatient care, with an emphasis on organized observations, medication-record verification and clear communication with the care team.
biography.en: Coordinates the nursing shift, patient handovers and follow-up documentation. Fifteen years of experience in inpatient care, with an emphasis on organized observations, medication-record verification and clear communication with the care team.
biography.es: Coordina el turno de enfermería, las entregas de pacientes y la documentación de seguimiento. Cuenta con quince años de experiencia en hospitalización, con énfasis en observaciones organizadas, verificación de registros de medicación y comunicación clara con el equipo asistencial.

headline.source: Registered nurse, inpatient care · California Valley Medical Center
headline.en: Registered nurse, inpatient care · California Valley Medical Center
headline.es: Enfermero de hospitalización · California Valley Medical Center

biography.source: Provides bedside nursing support and keeps patient observations and shift notes up to date. Works with the unit coordinator to prepare care handovers, organize supplies and document completed tasks for the next team.
biography.en: Provides bedside nursing support and keeps patient observations and shift notes up to date. Works with the unit coordinator to prepare care handovers, organize supplies and document completed tasks for the next team.
biography.es: Brinda apoyo de enfermería junto a la cama del paciente y mantiene actualizadas las observaciones y notas de turno. Trabaja con la coordinación de unidad para preparar entregas de atención, organizar suministros y documentar las tareas completadas para el siguiente equipo.

headline.source: Registered nurse and follow-up coordinator · California Valley Medical Center
headline.en: Registered nurse and follow-up coordinator · California Valley Medical Center
headline.es: Enfermera y coordinadora de seguimiento · California Valley Medical Center

biography.source: Coordinates patient follow-up, discharge documentation and communication with families and the care team. Focuses on clear instructions, complete records and continuity between inpatient care and scheduled reviews.
biography.en: Coordinates patient follow-up, discharge documentation and communication with families and the care team. Focuses on clear instructions, complete records and continuity between inpatient care and scheduled reviews.
biography.es: Coordina el seguimiento de pacientes, la documentación de alta y la comunicación con las familias y el equipo asistencial. Se centra en instrucciones claras, expedientes completos y continuidad entre la hospitalización y las revisiones programadas.

headline.source: Occupational therapist and care coordinator · Sonoran Neurological Institute
headline.en: Occupational therapist and care coordinator · Sonoran Neurological Institute
headline.es: Terapeuta ocupacional y coordinador de atención · Sonoran Neurological Institute

biography.source: Coordinates daily-living support and follow-up plans with the rehabilitation team. Helps organize routines, personal reminders and records of familiar objects so that patients and their authorized care network can review useful context together.
biography.en: Coordinates daily-living support and follow-up plans with the rehabilitation team. Helps organize routines, personal reminders and records of familiar objects so that patients and their authorized care network can review useful context together.
biography.es: Coordina el apoyo en actividades de la vida diaria y los planes de seguimiento con el equipo de rehabilitación. Ayuda a organizar rutinas, recordatorios personales y registros de objetos familiares para que los pacientes y su red de atención autorizada puedan revisar juntos el contexto útil.

biography.source: Works with the interdisciplinary team on cognitive assessment records and follow-up appointments. Organizes patient observations, session summaries and family guidance, keeping clinical interpretation separate from recorded reminders and visual evidence.
biography.en: Works with the interdisciplinary team on cognitive assessment records and follow-up appointments. Organizes patient observations, session summaries and family guidance, keeping clinical interpretation separate from recorded reminders and visual evidence.
biography.es: Trabaja con el equipo interdisciplinario en los registros de evaluación cognitiva y las citas de seguimiento. Organiza observaciones de pacientes, resúmenes de sesiones y orientación familiar, manteniendo separada la interpretación clínica de los recordatorios registrados y la evidencia visual.

headline.es: Asistente de rehabilitación · Sonoran Neurological Institute

biography.source: Supports scheduled rehabilitation activities, prepares materials and documents daily observations for the care team. Helps patients organize familiar objects and routines and keeps follow-up notes ready for the supervising professionals.
biography.en: Supports scheduled rehabilitation activities, prepares materials and documents daily observations for the care team. Helps patients organize familiar objects and routines and keeps follow-up notes ready for the supervising professionals.
biography.es: Apoya las actividades programadas de rehabilitación, prepara materiales y documenta observaciones diarias para el equipo asistencial. Ayuda a los pacientes a organizar objetos familiares y rutinas, y mantiene listas las notas de seguimiento para los profesionales supervisores.
